- **Module Lead**: Assoc. Prof. Guang HUA
- **Co-Lead**: Asst. Prof. Pulakesh UPADHYAYA
- **Co-Instructors**: Mr. Nai Tiong CHAN, Ms. Min Min CHAN
- **Schedule**: Tue 9–11am (Lectorials), Wed 9–11am (Labs)

## Course Overview

This module builds a solid foundation in data engineering, predictive modeling, and visualization using Quarto and R. Topics include the `tidyverse` package collection, time series analysis, and Naive Bayes classification, culminating in a team project.

## Learning Outcomes

1. Apply Quarto to document and present data workflow
2. Understand data engineering principles and practices
3. Apply supervised machine learning techniques in R
4. Assess data visualization effectiveness
5. Apply R packages for effective visualizations
6. Develop and deliver data analysis presentations
